Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: access restricted to local administrator
Preconditions: User is logged in as a non-administrator (e.g. doradca/mistrz warsztatu)

Step: Go to menu: Konfiguracja systemowa -> Planowanie Serwisu -> Serwis.
Verify if 'Ikony zdarzeń' menu item is NOT visible/accessible for non-administrator user.
Log out and log in as Local Administrator.
Go to menu: Konfiguracja systemowa -> Planowanie Serwisu -> Serwis.
Verify if 'Ikony zdarzeń' menu item is visible directly under 'Cechy napraw'.
Click 'Ikony zdarzeń'.
End of test.

Step: Go to menu: Konfiguracja systemowa -> Planowanie Serwisu -> Serwis -> Ikony zdarzeń.

Verify top panel of the page:

- button: 'Wyczyść filtry'

- Widoczne?
- Rodzaj zasobu
- Symbol
- Kolor
- Firma

'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded

- Zdarzenie
- Widoczny (Tak/Nie)
- Rodzaj zasobu (drop-down list)

- Kolor ikony (colour picker)

- Lokalizacja
- Instancja

- Doradca serwisowy
- Mechanik (serwis mechaniczny)

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: add new event - mandatory fields validation
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded

Step: Click 'Dodaj'.
Click 'Zapisz' without filling in any fields.
Expected result: Warning message occurs: 'Proszę poprawić błędy w formularzu'

Step:
Verify if mandatory fields are marked with red icon:
- Zdarzenie
- Widoczny
- Kolor
Fill in all mandatory fields and click 'Zapisz'.
Verify if the new event is visible on the events list.
Expected result: New event is visible on the list.

Step: End of test.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: add new event with parameter overloading
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded
At least one Firma, Lokalizacja and Instancja are available in the system

Step: Click 'Dodaj'.
Fill in mandatory fields (Zdarzenie, Widoczny, Kolor).
Select specific 'Rodzaj zasobu': Doradca serwisowy.
Select specific values for 'Firma', 'Lokalizacja', 'Instancja' (overload parameters).
Set 'Widoczny' = Tak and click 'Zapisz'.
Verify if new row is visible on the list with correct values in columns: Rodzaj zasobu, Firma, Lokalizacja, Instancja.
End of test.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: edit existing event
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded
At least one event exists on the list

Step: Click 'Edytuj' next to an existing event.
Verify if all previously configured values are correctly pre-filled in the form.
Change field 'Widoczny' to the opposite value and click 'Zapisz'.
Verify if the change is reflected on the events list.
End of test.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: delete event
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded
At least one event exists on the list (created for test purposes)

Step: Click 'Usuń' next to the event created for test purposes.
Click 'Nie'.
Verify if the event is still visible on the list.
Expected result: Event is visible on the list.

Step: Click 'Usuń' next to the event again.
Click 'Tak'.
Verify if the event is NOT visible on the list.
Expected result: Event is NOT visible on the list.

Step: End of test.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: priority/order configuration
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
'Ikony zdarzeń' page is loaded
At least 2 events exist on the list, both set as Widoczne = Tak

Step: Verify current priority/order of the two events (drag-and-drop list, analogous to work plans).
Change the priority/order between the two events via drag-and-drop.
Save the configuration.
Go to calendar (BOK or Warsztat) with a task where both events occur.
Manually refresh the calendar.
Verify if icon order on the task reflects the new priority configuration.
End of test.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: 'Widoczny' = Nie hides icon on calendar
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
Event is configured with 'Widoczny' = Tak, applicable to a resource/unit currently used on calendar
Task exists on calendar matching event conditions (icon currently visible)

Step: Go to calendar (BOK or Warsztat) and verify the event icon is displayed on the task.
Go to 'Ikony zdarzeń' page and edit the event, changing 'Widoczny' to Nie.
Click 'Zapisz'.
Expected result: Pop-up window is closed, configuration is saved.

Step: Verify that the calendar is NOT automatically refreshed (per business rule: no auto-refresh).
Expected result: Calendar view (if already open) remains unchanged until manual refresh.

Step: Manually refresh the calendar.
Verify that the icon is no longer displayed on the task.
End of test.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: configuration recalculates icons from current day forward
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
Event exists on both past and future tasks matching event conditions

Step: Configure the event 'Widoczny' = Nie and save.
Manually refresh the calendar and go to a date in the past (before today).
Expected result: Calendar page is displayed for past date.

Step: Verify if the icon is STILL displayed on past tasks (recalculation applies from current day forward only).
Expected result: Icon is displayed on past tasks (unchanged).

Step: Go to today's date and future dates.
Verify if the icon is NOT displayed on tasks from today onward.
Expected result: Icon is not displayed from today forward.

Step: End of test.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: resource type ('Rodzaj zasobu') scoped visibility
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
Event configured with 'Widoczny' = Tak and 'Rodzaj zasobu' = Doradca serwisowy only

Step: Go to calendar view with tasks assigned to Doradca serwisowy resource.
Verify if the event icon is displayed on tasks assigned to Doradca serwisowy.
Go to calendar view with tasks assigned to Mechanik (serwis mechaniczny) resource.
Verify if the event icon is NOT displayed on tasks assigned to Mechanik.
End of test.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: unit profile scoped visibility (BOK vs Warsztat)
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
Event configured with 'Widoczny' = Tak and 'Rodzaj profilu'/'Profil' set to BOK serwisowy only (specific unit)

Step: Go to BOK serwisowy calendar for the configured unit.
Verify if the event icon is displayed on matching tasks.
Go to Warsztat serwisowy calendar (different unit profile).
Verify if the event icon is NOT displayed on tasks in Warsztat calendar.
End of test.

Title: Konfiguracja - Ikony zdarzeń: overloading parameters priority (Firma/Lokalizacja/Instancja)
Preconditions:
User is logged in as Local Administrator
Two configurations exist for the same event:
- Configuration 1: general (no Firma/Lokalizacja/Instancja overload), Widoczny = Tak
- Configuration 2: overloaded for specific Lokalizacja, Widoczny = Nie

Step: Go to calendar for a unit belonging to the specific overloaded Lokalizacja.
Verify if the icon is NOT displayed on tasks (overloaded config takes precedence).
Go to calendar for a unit belonging to a different Lokalizacja (not overloaded).
Verify if the icon IS displayed on tasks (general config applies).
End of test.
